facts.fact: PATNUC's account says a workshop of the project's stakeholders in Yaounde on 3 July 2025 discussed the diagnostic for updating the Plan Cameroun Numerique 2020, and that the next step could come after government approval; no updated plan is stated as adopted.

systems.country_label: Projet d'accélération de la transformation numérique au Cameroun (PATNUC)

note: The document names the Plan Cameroun Numérique 2020 without describing its scope, so its class is empty for that reason; the only dated fact is the July 2025 diagnostic workshop on updating it.
